# Tool reference

The toolsets JARVIS exposes to the agent. Plugin toolsets come from the in-repo
plugins (see [plugins.md](plugins.md)) and are on whenever their plugin is in
`plugins.enabled`.

**The built-in list below is a manifest, not a switch.** It is read from
`deploy/config.template.yaml` (`tools.enabled` / `tools.disabled`), which records
which capabilities this deployment is *meant* to have — but Hermes v0.21.0 does
not read that block. The runtime's effective set comes from `platform_toolsets`
through `_get_platform_tools` (`hermes_cli/tools_config.py`), and Hermes has no
per-tool enable/disable for built-ins at all. Two places the manifest and the
runtime already disagree, both live:

* `text_to_speech` is not in the `hermes-api-server` composite, so the `tts`
  toolset is **not** enabled on the API-server platform — the platform the web
  console, the desktop app, the phone and the benchmark all use. It is in
  `hermes-cli`, so the CLI has it.
* `homeassistant` is in Hermes' `_DEFAULT_OFF_TOOLSETS` but is un-stripped
  whenever `HASS_TOKEN` is set, so the house tools are on regardless of this
  list.

The judgement to keep the block and label it rather than resolve it from the
composite is DEVIATIONS.md §23. What bounds a tool in practice is the
[approval matrix](approval-matrix.md), which is enforced rather than declared.

## Built-in toolsets

| Toolset | Name | State in JARVIS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `browser` | 🌐 Browser Automation | enabled |
| `clarify` | ❓ Clarifying Questions | off on api_server: not in the hermes-api-server composite (asking is a reply here, not a tool) |
| `code_execution` | ⚡ Code Execution | enabled |
| `computer_use` | 🖱️ Computer Use (macOS/Windows/Linux) | off on api_server: in tools.disabled; the desktop plugin replaces it (ADR-0040) |
| `context_engine` | 🧩 Context Engine | off on api_server: only with `context.engine: compressor`, which JARVIS does not set |
| `cronjob` | ⏰ Cron Jobs | enabled |
| `delegation` | 👥 Task Delegation | enabled |
| `file` | 📁 File Operations | enabled |
| `homeassistant` | 🏠 Home Assistant | enabled |
| `image_gen` | 🎨 Image Generation | enabled |
| `memory` | 💾 Memory | enabled |
| `session_search` | 🔎 Session Search | enabled |
| `skills` | 📚 Skills | enabled |
| `spotify` | 🎵 Spotify | off on api_server: needs a Spotify token |
| `stt` | 🎙️ Speech-to-Text | off on api_server: not in the hermes-api-server composite (the adapter transcribes) |
| `terminal` | 💻 Terminal & Processes | enabled |
| `todo` | 📋 Task Planning | enabled |
| `tts` | 🔊 Text-to-Speech | off on api_server: not in the hermes-api-server composite (`hud_say` speaks; DEVIATIONS §23) |
| `video` | 🎬 Video Analysis | off on api_server: in tools.disabled and needs a video-generation key |
| `video_gen` | 🎬 Video Generation | off on api_server: needs a video-generation key |
| `vision` | 👁️ Vision / Image Analysis | enabled |
| `web` | 🔍 Web Search & Scraping | enabled |
| `x_search` | 🐦 X (Twitter) Search | off on api_server: needs an xAI key |
| `yuanbao` | 🤖 Yuanbao | off on api_server: needs a Yuanbao token |
